opening.argument: The speaker expressly urges viewers to join Regal Coin and BitConnect lending programs, put money into them, and use the link to join his team while promising to make money. He presents a BitConnect lending wallet showing $78 and says, "I'm getting interest every day," then characterizes those returns as "passive income." The presentation also displays Regalcoin Programs and BitConnect branding and directs viewers to links below. Although he says, "please do your own research" and advises starting small, those qualifications do not change the explicit promotion of investment participation and income through the named lending programs.
